SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/MH/2023/909 Dated 01-11-2023
GSTIN: 27OOOPP3456O1Z2 M/s TransWorld Polymers
FY: 2022-23

1. Proper officer proposes disallowance of IGST credit of Rs. 2,80,000/- on imported raw chemical compounds claiming difference between customs bill of entry valuation and GST ledger reflection.
2. Taxpayer contends IGST was assessed and cleared at customs port under ICEGATE bill of entry.
